summary: Elderly man living with his mother left a note saying he was going to Trapper's Lake on 7/25; his vehicle was found about two weeks later parked off road 110 in the Slater Creek area north of Craig; SARDOC dog teams searched Oct 5, 2014 with Front Range Rescue Dogs; the Oct 28 search was stood down due to weather, with the search to resume in spring; no resolution reported.
location: Slater Creek area north of Craig
notes: SARDOC 2014 Fourth Quarter Mission Reports (parent-opened); subject unnamed; date is the departure date from the note he left ('going to Trapper's Lake on 7/25'); year 2014 per the Q4-2014 report context (searches Oct 5 and Oct 28, 2014). PDF is a quarterly summary also cited on ids 223 and 2372 for other incidents in the same document. Run 1020 chunk C.
